description: fetchngs writes a mag samplesheet whose read columns predate mag's short_reads_1/short_reads_2; the columns are renamed, each sample gets its own group, and each run keeps its own run id. fetchngs labels every run's reads ILLUMINA short reads; the short-read platform is taken from the run's ENA instrument_platform instead, so a long-read run (OXFORD_NANOPORE, PACBIO_SMRT) is refused rather than analysed as short reads. Different samples are not pooled for binning or assembly; use an inline handoff to supply study-specific pooling groups.
